description: This file defines the ViewsDataHelper class in the Drupal views module, providing methods to fetch and organize view field data, including caching and sorting functionalities.

classes.name: ViewsDataHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing and retrieving views data, including fetching fields and sorting them.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the helper with a ViewsData object.

methods.name: fetchFields
methods.description: Fetches a list of all available fields for a given base type, with options for grouping and subtypes.

methods.name: fetchedFieldSort
methods.description: Static method to sort fetched fields by group and title.
